verifiedPriorArtClaims.subject: Attenuating-agent-token draft is a finished standard
All workflow engines treat activity return as external truth
AP2 solves delegated authority and effect proof generally
A2A does not define native attenuation semantics
A2A does not define general independent effect verification
Completion truth terminology is too strong
Depth-1 local smoke test cannot establish joined research claim
Ananke plus Horae plus portable record/verifier may replace runtime

disputedOrQualifiedClaims: Attenuation prior art is substantial, but an active Internet-Draft is not a finished standard.
A2A TASK_STATE_UNSPECIFIED is an unknown or indeterminate task state, not an XA effect outcome.
Durable workflow results are durable records of execution, not universal proof of arbitrary external effects.
Provider signatures and transparency logs establish claims relative to trust roots; they do not create provider-independent truth.
The Fates Integration runtime-path criticism reflects an ambiguous diagram, while ACCORD-00 explicitly kept that repository evidence-only.
The oracle framing is a useful observation limit, not an impossibility theorem.
The review's 20–30% threshold was unsupported and is not adopted.

acceptedResearchQuestions.primary: For external effect surfaces with differing evidence affordances and delegates with differing reliability or honesty, what is the achievable trade-off among false confirmation, indeterminacy, duplicate effects, and human escalation, and can a portable, externally verifiable evidence record that binds authority to task/effect identity materially improve that trade-off over durable execution plus direct provider-state observation and a lightweight classifier baseline?
acceptedResearchQuestions.secondary: Under multi-hop delegation and sibling composition, does grant-level monotonic attenuation bound effective authority when parent-mediated laundering, composition, expiry, revocation, and resource dimensions are varied?

rejectedClaimsAndTerminology: whole-process escalation prevention without complete mediation
NO_VALID_AUTHORITY -> NO_EFFECT as a universal process-wide guarantee

componentOwnership.Adrasteia: portable linked authority/intent/task/effect/evidence record contracts and principal/observer representation
componentOwnership.Ananke: authority derivation, policy, approval binding, and mediated admission
componentOwnership.Horae: durable attempts, lifecycle, reconciliation, and authoritative effect state
componentOwnership.Mnemosyne: deferred provenance and governed memory context
componentOwnership.MCP: transport/tool fixture carrying the same authority and evidence boundary
componentOwnership.Firecracker: deferred; only for later whole-process mediation claims

unresolvedQuestions: Exact component-wise authority relations and composition semantics
How effective authority behaves under sibling composition and parent-mediated laundering
Evidence-class thresholds for each effect predicate
Provider-specific idempotency retention and expiry behavior
Revocation, cancellation, compensation, and saga semantics after dispatch
How to choose and pre-register metric thresholds after the pilot
Whether the portable record materially improves the durable-workflow/provider-state baseline
Which A2A and MCP versions are appropriate conformance fixtures
implementationGate: No implementation is allowed by ACCORD-01C; any later ACCORD-02 scope requires separate explicit acceptance.
